notes: Temporary chat is now a visible toggle that can be turned on and off on the current normal conversation
Work chats can no longer be moved into ordinary folders or detached from their workspace
Agent access now pauses inline for real Yes or No approval and resumes or cancels the requested tool action
Ask, Approve for me, and Full access now enforce distinct browser and file-action policies
Work responses show live, human-readable progress for file and browser steps
Ollama can now be downloaded, checksum-verified, and installed from GitHub on macOS as well as Windows
Persian and mixed-language input uses consistent bidirectional text handling across platforms
Only user-authored and response content is selectable; application chrome is protected from accidental selection
Settings navigation and the Agent access menu now use matching open and close motion
Workspace Browser sizing now adapts to its actual split width without overflowing the right edge
